passages.text: Now it was reported to David, “Look, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah and looting the threshing floors.”
passages.sermon:
David was a leader of Israel.
People brought news to David.
They said, “The Philistines are attacking Keilah.”
They said, “The Philistines are stealing grain from the threshing floors.”
passages.original: וַיַּגִּ֥דוּ לְדָוִ֖ד לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֤ה פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ נִלְחָמִ֣ים בִּקְעִילָ֔ה וְהֵ֖מָּה שֹׁסִ֥ים אֶת־ הַגֳּרָנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: So David inquired of the LORD, “Should I go and attack these Philistines?” And the LORD said to David, “Go and attack the Philistines and save Keilah.”
passages.sermon:
David was a leader of men.
David trusted God.
David asked the LORD a question.
David said, “Should I go and attack these Philistines?”
The LORD answered David.
The LORD said, “Go and attack the Philistines.”
The LORD said, “Save Keilah.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֨ל דָּוִ֤ד בַּֽיהוָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַאֵלֵ֣ךְ וְהִכֵּ֔יתִי בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּהס וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ דָּוִ֗ד לֵ֚ךְ וְהִכִּ֣יתָ בַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְהוֹשַׁעְתָּ֖ אֶת־ קְעִילָֽה׃

passages.text: But David’s men said to him, “Look, we are afraid here in Judah; how much more if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?”
passages.sermon:
David had men with him.
These men spoke to David.
They said, “We are afraid here in Judah.”
They said, “We will be even more afraid if we go to Keilah.”
They said, “In Keilah, we would face the armies of the Philistines.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י דָוִד֙ אֵלָ֔יו הִנֵּ֨ה אֲנַ֥חְנוּ פֹ֛ה בִּֽיהוּדָ֖ה יְרֵאִ֑ים וְאַף֙ כִּֽי־ נֵלֵ֣ךְ קְעִלָ֔ה אֶל־ מַֽעַרְכ֖וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃ס

passages.text: Once again, David inquired of the LORD, and the LORD answered him: “Go at once to Keilah, for I will deliver the Philistines into your hand.”
passages.sermon:
David was a leader of men.
David trusted the LORD.
David asked the LORD for guidance again.
The LORD answered David.
The LORD said, “Get up.
Go down to Keilah.
I will give the Philistines into your hand.”
passages.original: וַיּ֨וֹסֶף ע֤וֹד דָּוִד֙ לִשְׁאֹ֣ל בַּֽיהוָ֔הס וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֖הוּ יְהוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר ק֚וּם רֵ֣ד קְעִילָ֔ה כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י נֹתֵ֛ן אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Then David and his men went to Keilah, fought against the Philistines, and carried off their livestock, striking them with a mighty blow. So David saved the people of Keilah.
passages.sermon:
David was the leader of his men.
David and his men went to Keilah.
They fought against the Philistines.
They took the Philistines’ livestock.
They struck the Philistines with a mighty blow.
David saved the people of Keilah.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִד֩ וְאֲנָשׁוֹ קְעִילָ֜ה וַיִּלָּ֣חֶם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַיִּנְהַג֙ אֶת־ מִקְנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיַּ֥ךְ בָּהֶ֖ם מַכָּ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣שַׁע דָּוִ֔ד אֵ֖ת יֹשְׁבֵ֥י קְעִילָֽה׃ס

passages.text: (Now Abiathar son of Ahimelech had brought the ephod with him when he fled to David at Keilah.)
passages.sermon:
Abiathar was the son of Ahimelech.
Abiathar fled to David.
David was at Keilah.
Abiathar brought the ephod with him.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּ֠בְרֹחַ אֶבְיָתָ֧ר בֶּן־ אֲחִימֶ֛לֶךְ אֶל־ דָּוִ֖ד קְעִילָ֑ה אֵפ֖וֹד יָרַ֥ד בְּיָדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: When Saul was told that David had gone to Keilah, he said, “God has delivered him into my hand, for he has trapped himself by entering a town with gates and bars.”
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
Someone told Saul that David had gone to Keilah.
Saul believed God had given David into his hand.
Saul said David had trapped himself.
Saul said David entered a town with gates and bars.
passages.original: וַיֻּגַּ֣ד לְשָׁא֔וּל כִּי־ בָ֥א דָוִ֖ד קְעִילָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֗וּל נִכַּ֨ר אֹת֤וֹ אֱלֹהִים֙ בְּיָדִ֔י כִּ֚י נִסְגַּ֣ר לָב֔וֹא בְּעִ֖יר דְּלָתַ֥יִם וּבְרִֽיחַ׃

passages.text: Then Saul summoned all his troops to go to war at Keilah and besiege David and his men.
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
Saul heard that David was in Keilah.
Saul wanted to capture David.
Saul called all his soldiers.
He gathered the people for battle.
Saul led his army to Keilah.
He planned to attack the city.
He wanted to surround David and his men.
Saul intended to trap David and his followers.
passages.original: וַיְשַׁמַּ֥ע שָׁא֛וּל אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה לָרֶ֣דֶת קְעִילָ֔ה לָצ֥וּר אֶל־ דָּוִ֖ד וְאֶל־ אֲנָשָֽׁיו׃

passages.text: When David learned that Saul was plotting evil against him, he said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the ephod.”
passages.sermon:
David was a servant of God.
Saul was the king of Israel.
Saul wanted to harm David.
David learned that Saul was planning evil against him.
Abiathar was a priest.
David spoke to Abiathar.
David said, “Bring the ephod.”
passages.original: וַיֵּ֣דַע דָּוִ֔ד כִּ֣י עָלָ֔יו שָׁא֖וּל מַחֲרִ֣ישׁ הָרָעָ֑ה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ אֶבְיָתָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן הַגִּ֖ישָׁה הָאֵפֽוֹד׃ס

passages.text: And David said, “O LORD, God of Israel, Your servant has heard that Saul intends to come to Keilah and destroy the city on my account.
passages.sermon:
David spoke to God.
David called God “LORD, God of Israel.”
David said he was God’s servant.
David said he had heard news.
David said Saul wanted to come to Keilah.
David said Saul planned to destroy the city.
David said Saul wanted to destroy Keilah because of him.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ דָּוִד֒ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שָׁמֹ֤עַ שָׁמַע֙ עַבְדְּךָ֔ כִּֽי־ מְבַקֵּ֥שׁ שָׁא֖וּל לָב֣וֹא אֶל־ קְעִילָ֑ה לְשַׁחֵ֥ת לָעִ֖יר בַּעֲבוּרִֽי׃

passages.text: Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me into his hand? Will Saul come down, as Your servant has heard? O LORD, God of Israel, please tell Your servant.” “He will,” said the LORD.
passages.sermon:
David was in danger.
Saul was the king of Israel.
Saul wanted to harm David.
David was in the city of Keilah.
David spoke to God.
David said, “Will the people of Keilah hand me over to Saul?”
David said, “Will Saul come down to Keilah, as I have heard?”
David said, “LORD, God of Israel, please tell me.”
The LORD answered David.
The LORD said, “Saul will come down.”
passages.original: הֲיַסְגִּרֻ֣נִי בַעֲלֵי֩ קְעִילָ֨ה בְיָד֜וֹ הֲיֵרֵ֣ד שָׁא֗וּל כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ שָׁמַ֣ע עַבְדֶּ֔ךָ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַגֶּד־ נָ֖א לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָס וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה יֵרֵֽד׃

passages.text: So David asked, “Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me and my men into the hand of Saul?” “They will,” said the LORD.
passages.sermon:
David was a servant of God.
David was hiding from Saul.
Saul wanted to kill David.
David was in the city of Keilah.
David had men with him.
David asked God a question.
David said, "Will the people of Keilah hand me and my men over to Saul?"
The LORD answered David.
The LORD said, "They will surrender you."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔ד הֲיַסְגִּ֜רוּ בַּעֲלֵ֧י קְעִילָ֛ה אֹתִ֥י וְאֶת־ אֲנָשַׁ֖י בְּיַד־ שָׁא֑וּל וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה יַסְגִּֽירוּ׃ס

passages.text: Then David and his men, about six hundred strong, set out and departed from Keilah, moving from place to place. When Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah, he declined to go forth.
passages.sermon:
David was a leader.
He had about six hundred men with him.
David and his men left Keilah.
They went out together.
They moved from place to place.
Saul was the king.
Someone told Saul that David had escaped from Keilah.
Saul heard this news.
Saul stopped going out to look for David.
passages.original: וַיָּקָם֩ דָּוִ֨ד וַאֲנָשָׁ֜יו כְּשֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֣וֹת אִ֗ישׁ וַיֵּצְאוּ֙ מִקְּעִלָ֔ה וַיִּֽתְהַלְּכ֖וּ בַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ וּלְשָׁא֣וּל הֻגַּ֗ד כִּֽי־ נִמְלַ֤ט דָּוִד֙ מִקְּעִילָ֔ה וַיֶּחְדַּ֖ל לָצֵֽאת׃

passages.text: And David stayed in the wilderness strongholds and in the hill country of the Wilderness of Ziph. Day after day Saul searched for him, but God would not deliver David into his hand.
passages.sermon:
David was a man chosen by God.
David stayed in the wilderness.
He lived in strongholds.
He also stayed in the hill country.
This hill country was in the Wilderness of Ziph.
Saul was the king of Israel.
Saul searched for David every day.
God did not let Saul capture David.
God did not deliver David into Saul’s hand.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב דָּוִ֤ד בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ בַּמְּצָד֔וֹת וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בָּהָ֖ר בְּמִדְבַּר־ זִ֑יף וַיְבַקְשֵׁ֤הוּ שָׁאוּל֙ כָּל־ הַיָּמִ֔ים וְלֹֽא־ נְתָנ֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּיָדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: While David was in Horesh in the Wilderness of Ziph, he saw that Saul had come out to take his life.
passages.sermon:
David was in Horesh.
Horesh is in the Wilderness of Ziph.
David saw Saul.
Saul had come out.
Saul wanted to take David’s life.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣רְא דָוִ֔ד כִּֽי־ יָצָ֥א שָׁא֖וּל לְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אֶת־ נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְדָוִ֥ד בְּמִדְבַּר־ זִ֖יף בַּחֹֽרְשָׁה׃ס

passages.text: And Saul’s son Jonathan came to David in Horesh and strengthened his hand in God, saying, “Do not be afraid, for my father Saul will never lay a hand on you. And you will be king over Israel, and I will be your second-in-command. Even my father Saul knows this is true.”
passages.sermon:
Jonathan was Saul’s son.
Jonathan went to David.
David was in Horesh.
Jonathan encouraged David.
Jonathan gave David strength in God.
Jonathan spoke to David.
Jonathan said, “Do not be afraid.”
Jonathan said, “My father Saul will not catch you.”
Jonathan said, “You will be king over Israel.”
Jonathan said, “I will be your second-in-command.”
Jonathan said, “My father Saul knows this is true.”
passages.original: וַיָּ֙קָם֙ יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן בֶּן־ שָׁא֔וּל וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ אֶל־ דָּוִ֖ד חֹ֑רְשָׁה וַיְחַזֵּ֥ק אֶת־ יָד֖וֹ בֵּאלֹהִֽים׃ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו אַל־ תִּירָ֗א כִּ֠י לֹ֤א תִֽמְצָאֲךָ֙ יַ֚ד שָׁא֣וּל אָבִ֔י וְאַתָּה֙ תִּמְלֹ֣ךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָנֹכִ֖י אֶֽהְיֶה־ לְּךָ֣ לְמִשְׁנֶ֑ה וְגַם־ שָׁא֥וּל אָבִ֖י יֹדֵ֥עַ כֵּֽן׃

passages.text: So the two of them made a covenant before the LORD. And David remained in Horesh, while Jonathan went home.
passages.sermon:
David was in Horesh.
Jonathan was Saul’s son.
David and Jonathan made a covenant.
They made this covenant before the LORD.
David stayed in Horesh.
Jonathan went home.
passages.original: וַיִּכְרְת֧וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֛ם בְּרִ֖ית לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב דָּוִד֙ בַּחֹ֔רְשָׁה וִיהוֹנָתָ֖ן הָלַ֥ךְ לְבֵיתֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: Then the Ziphites came up to Saul at Gibeah and said, “Is not David hiding among us in the strongholds at Horesh, on the hill of Hachilah south of Jeshimon?
passages.sermon:
The Ziphites were people who lived near Horesh.
Saul was the king of Israel.
The Ziphites went to Saul at Gibeah.
They spoke to Saul.
They said, “David is hiding among us.”
They said, “He is in the strongholds at Horesh.”
They said, “He is on the hill of Hachilah.”
They said, “This hill is south of Jeshimon.”
passages.original: וַיַּעֲל֤וּ זִפִים֙ אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל הַגִּבְעָ֖תָה לֵאמֹ֑ר הֲל֣וֹא דָ֠וִד מִסְתַּתֵּ֨ר עִמָּ֤נוּ בַמְּצָדוֹת֙ בַּחֹ֔רְשָׁה בְּגִבְעַת֙ הַֽחֲכִילָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִימִ֥ין הַיְשִׁימֽוֹן׃

passages.text: Now, O king, come down whenever your soul desires, and we will be responsible for delivering him into your hand.”
passages.sermon:
The Ziphites spoke to King Saul.
They said, “King, you may come down whenever you want.
You may come down at any time you desire.
We will hand David over to you.
We will deliver him into your hand.”
passages.original: וְ֠עַתָּה לְכָל־ אַוַּ֨ת נַפְשְׁךָ֥ הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ לָרֶ֖דֶת רֵ֑ד וְלָ֥נוּ הַסְגִּיר֖וֹ בְּיַ֥ד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: “May you be blessed by the LORD,” replied Saul, “for you have had compassion on me.
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
Saul spoke to the Ziphites.
Saul said, “May the LORD bless you.”
Saul said this because the Ziphites showed compassion to him.
The Ziphites helped Saul by telling him about David’s hiding place.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל בְּרוּכִ֥ים אַתֶּ֖ם לַֽיהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י חֲמַלְתֶּ֖ם עָלָֽי׃

passages.text: Please go and prepare further. Investigate and watch carefully where he goes and who has seen him there, for I am told that he is extremely cunning.
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
Saul spoke to his servants.
He told them to go and prepare more.
He told them to investigate carefully.
He told them to watch where David goes.
He told them to find out who has seen David there.
Saul said that people told him David is very cunning.
passages.original: לְכוּ־ נָ֞א הָכִ֣ינוּ ע֗וֹד וּדְע֤וּ וּרְאוּ֙ אֶת־ מְקוֹמוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה רַגְל֔וֹ מִ֥י רָאָ֖הוּ שָׁ֑ם כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֔י עָר֥וֹם יַעְרִ֖ם הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Observe and find out all the places where he hides. Then come back to me with certainty, and I will go with you. If he is in the land, I will search him out among all the clans of Judah.”
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
Saul spoke to his men.
He told them to observe every hiding place where David might hide.
He told them to find out all the places David could be hiding.
He told them to return to him with certain information.
He said he would go with them.
He said if David was in the land, he would search for David.
He said he would search for David among all the clans of Judah.
passages.original: וּרְא֣וּ וּדְע֗וּ מִכֹּ֤ל הַמַּֽחֲבֹאִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתְחַבֵּ֣א שָׁ֔ם וְשַׁבְתֶּ֤ם אֵלַי֙ אֶל־ נָכ֔וֹן וְהָלַכְתִּ֖י אִתְּכֶ֑ם וְהָיָה֙ אִם־ יֶשְׁנ֣וֹ בָאָ֔רֶץ וְחִפַּשְׂתִּ֣י אֹת֔וֹ בְּכֹ֖ל אַלְפֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: So they set out and went to Ziph ahead of Saul. Now David and his men were in the Wilderness of Maon in the Arabah south of Jeshimon, and Saul and his men went to seek him. When David was told about it, he went down to the rock and stayed in the Wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard of this, he pursued David there.
passages.sermon:
David was a leader.
David had men with him.
David and his men were in the Wilderness of Maon.
This wilderness was in the Arabah.
The Arabah was south of Jeshimon.
Saul was the king.
Saul had men with him.
Some people went to Ziph before Saul arrived.
Saul and his men went to look for David.
Someone told David that Saul was coming.
David went down to the rock.
David stayed in the Wilderness of Maon.
Saul heard where David was.
Saul chased David in the Wilderness of Maon.
passages.original: וַיָּק֛וּמוּ וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ זִ֖יפָה לִפְנֵ֣י שָׁא֑וּל וְדָוִ֨ד וַאֲנָשָׁ֜יו בְּמִדְבַּ֤ר מָעוֹן֙ בָּעֲרָבָ֔ה אֶ֖ל יְמִ֥ין הַיְשִׁימֽוֹן׃ וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ שָׁא֣וּל וַאֲנָשָׁיו֮ לְבַקֵּשׁ֒ וַיַּגִּ֣דוּ לְדָוִ֔ד וַיֵּ֣רֶד הַסֶּ֔לַע וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר מָע֑וֹן וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע שָׁא֔וּל וַיִּרְדֹּ֥ף אַחֲרֵֽי־ דָוִ֖ד מִדְבַּ֥ר מָעֽוֹן׃

passages.text: Saul was proceeding along one side of the mountain, and David and his men along the other side. Even though David was hurrying to get away, Saul and his men were closing in on David and his men to capture them.
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
David was a servant of God and the future king.
Saul walked on one side of the mountain.
David and his men walked on the other side of the mountain.
David hurried to escape from Saul.
Saul and his men tried to surround David and his men.
Saul wanted to capture David and his men.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ שָׁא֜וּל מִצַּ֤ד הָהָר֙ מִזֶּ֔ה וְדָוִ֧ד וַאֲנָשָׁ֛יו מִצַּ֥ד הָהָ֖ר מִזֶּ֑ה וַיְהִ֨י דָוִ֜ד נֶחְפָּ֤ז לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י שָׁא֔וּל וְשָׁא֣וּל וַאֲנָשָׁ֗יו עֹֽטְרִ֛ים אֶל־ דָּוִ֥ד וְאֶל־ אֲנָשָׁ֖יו לְתָפְשָֽׂם׃

passages.text: Then a messenger came to Saul, saying, “Come quickly, for the Philistines have raided the land!”
passages.sermon:
A messenger came to Saul.
The messenger spoke to Saul.
The messenger said, “Come quickly.”
The messenger said, “The Philistines have raided the land.”
passages.original: וּמַלְאָ֣ךְ בָּ֔א אֶל־ שָׁא֖וּל לֵאמֹ֑ר מַהֲרָ֣ה וְלֵ֔כָה כִּֽי־ פָשְׁט֥וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: So Saul broke off his pursuit of David and went to meet the Philistines. That is why that place is called Sela-hammahlekoth.
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
Saul had been chasing David.
Saul stopped chasing David.
Saul went to fight the Philistines.
People called that place Sela-hammahlekoth.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣שָׁב שָׁא֗וּל מִרְדֹף֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י דָוִ֔ד וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ לִקְרַ֣את פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים עַל־ כֵּ֗ן קָֽרְאוּ֙ לַמָּק֣וֹם הַה֔וּא סֶ֖לַע הַֽמַּחְלְקֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En-gedi.
passages.sermon:
David was a man chosen by God.
David left that place.
David went up from there.
David lived in the strongholds of En-gedi.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַל דָּוִ֖ד מִשָּׁ֑ם וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בִּמְצָד֥וֹת עֵֽין־ גֶּֽדִי׃
